description:
👋 Hi, I'm a builder who loves turning rough ideas into working demos, fast.

About me I'm a hands-on problem solver with a background in software development and a strong interest in AI, automation, and tools that make everyday work easier. I like the hackathon pace: scoping tightly, shipping something real, and polishing the story at the end.
summary:
We developed an AI-powered agricultural decision-support platform that transforms static historical crop maps into actionable future harvest forecasts. Building upon county-level satellite data covering over 40 crops and 50 counties, we expanded the historical baseline from 2017–2018 to a comprehensive six-year dataset (2017–2022) to train a Machine Learning yield prediction model.

Farmers often face high financial risk because traditional platforms only show past averages without forecasting future performance or comparing trade-offs. Our solution addresses this challenge by analyzing multi-year soil quality, yield, and revenue-per-acre patterns to generate three tailored planting options—high-yield, balanced, and soil-resilient—each presented with projected financial returns, pros, and cons.

This project is important because it bridges the gap between complex data science and real-world farming. By delivering transparent, predictive insights while ensuring the farmer always retains the final say, the platform reduces economic uncertainty, optimizes water and soil sustainability, and empowers growers to make confident, data-driven decisions.
details:
Our web platform maps 40+ crops and 50+ counties across three layers: Primary Crop, Revenue per Acre, and Soil Quality. By expanding historical data from 2017–2018 to a six-year dataset (2017–2022), we train a Machine Learning model to forecast future harvests and recommend three tailored planting scenarios (High-Yield, Balanced, and Soil-Resilient) with clear pros and cons.

Benefits & Impact It replaces backward-looking guesswork with predictive foresight—lowering financial risk, preventing soil depletion, and helping everyday growers make sustainable, data-driven decisions.

Tools & Tech Built with React/Next.js, TypeScript, Google Maps API, and Vercel for the web interface, alongside Python (Pandas, Scikit-learn) for data processing and ML yield forecasting.

Creativity & Key Factors Rather than acting as a "black box" that dictates one crop, our human-in-the-loop approach compares trade-offs so the farmer always has the final say, while transparently accounting for county-level averages, 1–10 acre soil limits, and data gaps.
